pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Python SDK for smolVM, a lightweight microVM runtime providing sandboxed environments for secure code execution. The client talks to a running smolVM server over HTTP (default: http://127.0.0.1:8080) and offers an async API for managing machine lifecycles, executing commands, running OCI containers, and language presets.
Part of the smolvm-sdk monorepo; this package covers the smolvm-python subdirectory.
